Game Overview

Death Worm is a action title where unleash chaos as the fearsome Death Worm, tunneling underground to shatter through the surface in explosive assaults. Navigate through diverse modes, target unsuspecting prey, and create monumental destruction in a thrilling blend of arcade action and strategy. Can you master the beast's insatiable hunger?
